preinstall.settings_hint: Reopen the preset wizard to re-select or install recommended plugins.

update.check_failed: Failed to check for updates — check your network and try again later

update.rolled_back: The new Core failed startup validation, so the last working version was restored.
update.desktop_downloaded: Installer already downloaded — ready to open

update.desktop_opened: Installer opened — follow the prompts to complete the update
about.title: About
errors.service_start_timeout: MIR3 AI Core startup timeout. Please check whether port {{port}} is occupied or the startup is too slow.
errors.plugin_route_conflict: Detected a plugin route conflict: two plugins registered the same route twice. Uninstall the recently added plugin from the Plugins panel, or run mir3 plugin --profile <profile> remove <package> for the active profile and retry.
errors.install_verify_failed: Package downloaded but installation verification failed.
errors.network_timeout: Network download timeout. Please check your network connection.
ui.cli_link_status_ok: Enabled — type mir3 in a new terminal
ui.cli_link_status_partial: Enabled but PATH registration incomplete — try saving again
ui.cli_link_hint: Run mir3 --help in a new terminal
ui.cli_link_user_core_preserved: An existing mir3 command was detected and preserved; MIR3 Studio AI did not overwrite it
ui.iframe_error: Cannot load the MIR3 AI Core interface.
ui.ensure_running: Please make sure the service is running at {{url}}.
messages.port_restart_hint: It takes effect after the service restarts. Restart now?
messages.cli_link_enabled: mir3 command enabled — open a new terminal to use it
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.tooltip: Profiles are isolated bundles of plugins, patches and settings in MIR3 AI Core. Create new profiles to trial different plugin combinations without affecting the current setup.
profiles.activate_confirm_desc: Switch to the {{name}} profile? Its plugins and settings will be used from now on.
profiles.activate_restart_hint: Takes effect after the service restarts. Restart now?
profiles.remove_confirm_desc: Delete {{name}} permanently? Its plugins and settings will be removed. This cannot be undone.
plugins.panel_tooltip: Installed plugins, read-only. Plugins normally need no management here — upgrade or uninstall one only when it is causing problems.
plugins.changelog_local_hint: This plugin is bundled offline with MIR3 Studio AI and is upgraded by Studio, not separately through the plugin market.
plugins.changelog_optional_hint: This plugin is available offline in the installer but remains enabled, updated, or removed through the native Harness plugin flow.
plugins.changelog_empty: This installer does not include a changelog.
plugins.abnormal_tooltip: This plugin is running abnormally. Click to view details.
plugins.error_parse: Failed to read the plugin's metadata (package.json is missing or corrupt).
plugins.abnormal_desc: Plugin {{name}} is abnormal and may be corrupted or incompatible with the current environment.
plugins.remove_confirm_desc: Uninstall {{name}}? Its features will no longer be available after removal.
plugins.safe_files_dirty: MIR3 Safe Files still has unsaved edits. Save them to Draft or close the editor first.
plugins.copy_failed: Failed to copy the error log
core.title: MIR3 AI Core
core.tooltip: MIR3 AI Core powers the desktop workspace. Manage local copies of each version here — switch the running version, or uninstall ones you no longer need.
core.local_hint: installed via CLI before Desktop was set up
core.switch_confirm_desc: Switch to the {{version}} version? The running engine will change to this copy.
core.remove_confirm_desc: Uninstall {{version}}? The engine copy will be removed from this device (other copies are unaffected).
core.update_failed: Failed to update the local core
core.download_failed: Failed to download the core version
core.remove_failed: Failed to uninstall the core version
core.local_missing_hint: No compatible local core was detected. MIR3 Studio AI will continue using its managed core.
recovery.remove_one: Remove this plugin and continue checking
recovery.remove_many: Remove these {{count}} plugins and continue checking
recovery.safety_note: Your workspaces, sessions, model settings, and other plugins will not be removed.
recovery.summary_exhausted: This issue keeps repeating after attempts. Open the MIR3 AI Core log for the detailed error, or remove the plugin manually from the Plugins panel.
recovery.reason.duplicate_route.title: A plugin registered a duplicate service route
recovery.reason.duplicate_route.detail: The startup log shows that {{detail}} was registered more than once, so MIR3 AI Core could not continue.
recovery.reason.duplicate_loader_entry.t: A plugin registered a duplicate service component
recovery.reason.duplicate_loader_entry.d: The startup log shows that component {{detail}} was registered more than once due to a plugin conflict.
recovery.reason.cannot_resolve_bundle.ti: The plugin is not fully installed
recovery.reason.cannot_resolve_bundle.de: The profile still references this plugin, but its package cannot be found locally.
recovery.reason.no_dsh_bundle.title: The package is not a compatible MIR3 plugin
recovery.reason.no_dsh_bundle.detail: It does not declare the entry point required by MIR3 AI Core.
recovery.reason.slot_conflict.title: A plugin has a UI slot conflict
recovery.reason.slot_conflict.detail: UI slot {{detail}} has duplicate registrations from conflicting plugins.
recovery.reason.load_failed.title: The plugin code could not be loaded
recovery.reason.load_failed.detail: Its files may be damaged, missing a dependency, or incompatible with this MIR3 AI Core version.
recovery.reason.runtime.title: A plugin is running abnormally
recovery.reason.runtime.detail: The plugin reported a runtime error. Removing it and continuing may resolve the issue.
recovery.reason.unknown.title: A plugin failed during startup
recovery.reason.unknown.detail: MIR3 AI Core reported an error while loading a plugin, but the exact cause could not be determined automatically.
studio.shell.subtitle: 996 MIR3 Development
studio.nav.label: Studio primary navigation
studio.placeholder.title: The interface is ready; functionality will follow in later phases
studio.placeholder.description: This phase does not create project data, run builds or processes, or display simulated results.
studio.project.title: Start from a trusted 996 project
studio.project.description: Open a project created by 996 Project Manager. Studio only registers its folders and stores indexes, Drafts, and backups externally.
studio.project.list_desc: The project root must directly contain Client and Engine folders.
studio.project.switch_confirm: Switching projects restarts MIR3 AI Core and stops any running Agent task. Continue?
studio.project.remove_confirm: This only removes the project registration from MIR3 Studio. Client and engine files are not deleted. Continue?
studio.project.index_desc: Classified results stay in Studio data and are never written into the 996 project.
studio.project.workspace_desc: A workspace can only be the project root or one of its real descendants.
studio.project.drafts_desc: Agent changes remain in external Drafts until they are previewed and confirmed.
studio.project.preview_desc: Confirmation creates a snapshot and only applies the exact revision shown here.
studio.project.binary_change: Text diff is unavailable for a binary change
studio.project.snapshots_desc: Snapshots are stored in Studio data and can be restored manually.
studio.project.restore_confirm: Restoring this snapshot will overwrite its project files. Continue?
studio.project.create_desc: Create a MIR3 workspace in an empty folder. No files are written in this phase.
studio.project.open_desc: Select and recognize an existing 996 server folder. Scanning is not enabled in this phase.
studio.project.guard.source_desc: The original project is never overwritten directly
studio.project.guard.draft_desc: Every change first enters a reviewable draft
studio.project.guard.acceptance_desc: In-game results decide whether work passes
studio.project.recent_empty_desc: Create a project in 996 Project Manager first, then choose the root that contains Client and Engine.
studio.builds.title: Immutable Rxx and integrated RC
studio.builds.description: Builds will bind change manifests, file hashes, and acceptance status so every test round remains traceable.
studio.builds.empty_desc: Rxx test packages and RC candidates will appear here after project and version management are connected.
studio.runtime.title: Isolated 996 test instance
studio.runtime.description: Deploy a selected build to an isolated folder and observe processes, ports, and services without touching production servers.
studio.runtime.profile_desc: Test folder, server entry point, client entry point, and important ports.
studio.runtime.unconfigured_desc: Runtime management will be connected in a later phase.
studio.runtime.processes_desc: Shows the real status of M2 and its child processes.
studio.runtime.stopped_desc: This phase will not start or stop any game process.
studio.feedback.title: Bring in-game results back into development
studio.feedback.description: Every acceptance result will be bound to a specific build, test environment, and human observation.
studio.feedback.compose_desc: Choose a build and record the real actions and observed results.
studio.feedback.empty_desc: Test evidence bound to builds will appear here after acceptance functionality is connected.
studio.knowledge.title: Project rules
studio.knowledge.description: Manage development rules verified against the current 996 project.
studio.knowledge.empty: Project rules are not available yet
studio.knowledge.empty_desc: The rule model will be connected in a later phase. Existing data is not migrated, modified, or deleted by this change.
studio.settings.title: MIR3 project preferences
studio.settings.description: This area only holds project scanning, indexing, and safety policy; it does not create a second model or AI configuration.
studio.settings.project_group_desc: These capabilities will be enabled in their corresponding development phases.
studio.settings.scan_desc: Configure recognition for Map, NPC, Monster, Item, Quest, Lua, and Config.
studio.settings.index_desc: Manage text encodings, incremental scanning, and project index storage.
studio.settings.safety_desc: Control previews, backups, Drafts, and acceptance gates.
studio.settings.mcp_missing: MCP sidecar has not been built
studio.settings.app_config_hint: Core, profiles, plugins, and desktop updates remain available from Application in the top bar.
studio.logs.title: Project operations and acceptance events
studio.logs.description: Scanning, indexing, changes, builds, and test events will appear here; Core run logs remain available from the top bar.
studio.logs.search: Search errors, status codes, or operations
studio.logs.empty_desc: Real events will appear after MIR3 project capabilities are connected; no simulated entries are generated.
